apps.name: Telar Clips
apps.blurb: Free motion backgrounds, illustrated scenes and green screens for greetings, reels, intros and school or church videos.

apps.name: PizarraPad
apps.blurb: A free online whiteboard, blackboard and greenboard for the classroom projector. Write with a stylus, finger or mouse, add pictures, works offline.

apps.name: QuizPolice
apps.blurb: Free quiz monitoring for Google Forms, Microsoft Forms and Wayground. See live who left the quiz tab, and for how long.

apps.name: DraftTrail
apps.blurb: A writing recorder that replays how an essay was written, step by step, so teachers can see the process, not just the result.

apps.name: Tixward
apps.blurb: Sell event tickets and take bookings for courts and rooms. Buyers pay you directly by e-wallet, bank QR, card link or cash, and get QR tickets. Free for most events.

apps.name: Telar Stories
apps.blurb: Turn illustrated scenes and characters into 2 to 3 minute narrated story videos for classrooms, Sunday school, organization promos, and parents making simple custom stories for their children.
apps.blurb_live: Make narrated picture-book story videos: pick a ready-made story or write your own, add characters, a free AI storyteller voice or your own, and download an MP4 for class, church or family.
